title: From Faro: The Original Benagil Cave, Marinha & More Tour
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Prepare for an unforgettable coastal journey from Faro to the awe-inspiring Benagil Cave, a hidden treasure along the Algarve coastline. This isn't your ordinary tour; it's an adventure that promises excitement, unparalleled discovery, and incredible vistas, offering you a once-in-a-lifetime encounter with the Algarve's coastal splendour. On top of that we'll if you're feeling up for some excitement, we'll take you to some secret caves and grottos.

Itinerary:
1.Start:
Your adventure kicks off at Faro Marina, where our spirited local instructor will be eagerly waiting for you. Step aboard our comfortable mini bus as we embark on an exhilarating coastal expedition.

2: Algar Seco & Boneca a Coastal Adventure:
Our first destination is the breathtaking Algar Seco, where the adventure truly begins. You will have the chance to adventure a long coastal trails and pathways that wind their way through this picturesque landscape. You'll also get to see Boneca cave often referred to as "The Doll's Cave," is a captivating sea cave situated within the Algar Seco area.

3: Benagil Cave Tour From Above:
Delve into the extraordinary as we unveil the wondrous Benagil Cave. While venturing inside is no longer possible, we've uncovered an exhilarating way to witness its grandeur. We'll lead you to a jaw-dropping viewpoint from which you can gaze in awe at the colossal sea cavern, a moment that will send shivers down your spine.

4: Marinha Beach Paradise:
The thrill continues as we make our way to Marinha Beach, a place of unparalleled beauty with its dramatic cliffs and crystal-clear waters. Dive into the Seven Hanging Valleys, a paradise for adventure seekers. Whether you're swimming, exploring, or just basking in the tranquillity, this is a piece of heaven on Earth.
If you're feeling brave, we've even prepared a few sorties to secret caves and grottos that are still accessible.

5: Cliffside Spectacular:
Throughout this escapade, you'll be treated to spectacular cliffside panoramas that are nothing short of mesmerising. Each viewpoint is a photo opportunity, a memory etched in time.

6: Return to Faro in Comfort:
As the day winds down, our trusty mini bus will pick you up from Marinha Beach, ensuring a seamless return to Faro Marina. You'll find yourself back at the heart of Faro, where you can further extend your adventure or easily make your way back to your accommodations.

This is more than a cave tour, a hop on and off or walking tour; it's an incredible voyage into the Algarve's coastal paradise. Don't miss this opportunity to create unforgettable memories. Book your spot now and embark on the adventure of a lifetime!

title: From Faro: Boat trip to Benagil Cave & Praia da Marinha
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
We start our tour at the meeting point in front of Faro Train Station. Please arrive at 8h00 for morning departure at 8h20 or 14h00 for afternoon departure at 14h20.

Then, we travel towards Armacao de Pera in our air-conditioned Van. Arrived at Armacao de Pera, our Boat Tour towards Benagil starts by climbing aboard the boat on the beach sand. This tour includes an onboard visit to the magnificent arches and cliffs of Praia da Marinha. (Arches of Marinha Beach). Discover the 10 caves carved by the sea: the Benagil Cave, The Pirates Cave, The Crocodile Cave, The Daw Cave and much more. Finish the boat tour in style returning to Armacao de Pera beach.

Expert Tip: We will be visiting the Caves and surrounding cliffs. In this scenario, photos and videos are simply amazing, and you will have the opportunity to keep fantastic memories. The cliffs and Praia da Marinha are among the 40 most beautiful beaches in the world! Included in the Michelin guide.

After we finish our boat tour we then take a 10-minute van ride towards Praia de Nossa Senhora da Rocha.

In Nossa Senhora da Rocha we can enjoy some time on the beach (if the weather is fine). Enjoy snorkeling and relax in the shade of a parasol we provide.

Finally, visit the Senhora da Rocha chapel, an ancient building perched on a cliff—a rare beauty surrounded by picturesque natural scenery.

Return to Faro on our cozy air-conditioned van. This is going to be a memorable experience.

title: From Faro: Benagil Cave, Marinha & Carvoeiro Full-Day Tour

description:
Embark on an unforgettable full-day tour from Faro to explore the stunning beauty of the Algarve coastline—perfect for nature lovers, curious travelers, and adventure seekers!

Your day starts with a comfortable pickup right next to the Faro Customs House (Alfândega de Faro). From there, we’ll take you on a relaxing drive to one of the most beautiful places in Portugal.

First stop: the golden cliffs of Praia da Marinha, where you’ll enjoy incredible views and walk along scenic trails all the way to the famous heart-shaped rock. Breathe in the sea air and soak up the natural beauty.

Then, we head to the top of the iconic Benagil Cave*.

Next, we take a break in the charming village of Carvoeiro. You’ll have time to grab a tasty lunch, explore the area, or simply chill on the beach if the weather’s nice.

After lunch, we walk along the Carvoeiro Boardwalk to Algar Seco, a magical spot with crazy rock formations and stunning sea views.

Feeling brave? If the weather allows, you can even jump from the cliffs—it's totally optional, but seriously fun!

At the end of the day, we’ll take you back to Faro, full of stories, smiles, and memories you won’t forget.

What makes this tour special:

title: Top Rated From Faro: Benagil, Marinha, 7 Valleys, Algar Seco
cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Embark into the paradise of the Algarve Coast.

Departing from Faro in a comfortable van equipped with air conditioning and karaoke microphone, enjoy a peaceful and exciting journey to the municipality of Lagoa, where the scenery of this adventure awaits.

The first stop is Benagil, home to one of the most famous caves in the world, the extraordinary Algar de Benagil or Benagil Cave. The lush views of the cliffs, beach, and caves of the area will make an invitation to happiness.

We will start our adventure taking a short walk to Benagil's viewpoint, passing through a small fishing village. Immerse yourself in the culture and history of the area. After enjoying the view from the viewpoint, we will descend to visit Benagil Beach and prepare for HIKING on the Seven Hanging Valleys Trail.

During the hike between Benagil and Praia da Marinha along the Seven Hanging Valleys Trail, your guide will inform you about interesting facts and aspects about the fauna, flora and geology of the region. The views from the top of Benagil Cave, Praia da Corredoura, The Gigante, Praia da Mesquita and Praia da Marinha will leave you breathless. You will visit incredible sites such as Elephant Rock, the Mini Canyon and the Secret Heart of the Seven Valleys.

After the hike, you will have free time to refresh and relax at one of the most beautiful beaches in the world, Marinha Beach. The crystal-clear waters and golden sands will make a brilliant invitation to explore this beauty. Ask your guide about the secret spots! The Lunch break takes place during free time (read the recommendations in the "Know Before You Go" section).

At Algar Seco, the galleries and caves carved into the limestone rock will amaze you. The legends about this natural monument will take you on a journey through the beginnings of Portugal. The fossils embedded in the rocky coast will convince you that nature is sovereign.

To finish, a cliff jump into the deep waters of the North Atlantic will provide a farewell full of adrenaline and excitement.

When you return to Faro, you will have the feeling of having lived in a movie.

Discover the stunning Algarve coastline on a half-day adventure combining sea kayaking, coastal walks, and free time to relax. Depart from Faro in a comfortable air-conditioned van and experience the perfect mix of nature, exploration, and excitement.

Start your journey with an incredible adventure to visit the iconic Benagil Cave — the cave that appears on postcards, your computer’s screensaver, and in photos everyone dreams of taking. Then continue exploring some nearby grottos and hidden beaches during a one-hour kayak tour.

title: From Faro: Benagil, Algar Seco & Marinha Beach Tour

description:
Leave Faro behind and discover the dramatic coastline of the Algarve on a small-group land adventure with a local guide.

Travel between some of the region’s most distinctive coastal landscapes, combining scenic viewpoints, sea-carved rock formations, a coastal walk, and relaxing time at one of the Algarve’s most iconic beaches.

See Benagil Cave from above and admire its famous natural opening, limestone cliffs, and ocean surroundings from a unique viewpoint. This stop offers an impressive perspective of the cave without entering it by boat, kayak, or paddleboard.

Continue to Algar Seco, where the Atlantic Ocean has shaped the limestone cliffs into tunnels, passages, natural windows, and unusual rock formations. Explore the area on foot, enjoy the sea views, and discover the natural character of the Algarve coastline.

Walk along part of the Seven Hanging Valleys Trail, following a scenic route above the cliffs. Take in panoramic viewpoints and photograph hidden coves, coastal arches, and the contrast between the golden cliffs and the Atlantic Ocean.

Visit Marinha Beach, where you will have free time to relax on the sand, swim when conditions allow, take photographs, or simply enjoy the peaceful surroundings.

With transportation from Faro, a local guide, and a maximum of 8 participants, this tour offers a relaxed and memorable way to experience several Algarve highlights in one day.

The activity takes place entirely on land and includes walking over uneven coastal terrain.

cancellationDescription: Cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund
description:
Discover the best of the Algarve Coastline without stress, without lines, and without the need for a car. This tour offers comfortable transportation and experienced guides from Faro to three of the most famous places in the Algarve: Marinha Beach, Benagil, and Algar Seco.
It's the perfect option for those who want complete freedom to explore at their own pace.

The experience begins with pickup in Faro, where you embark on a scenic journey to Praia da Marinha, considered one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. Here you will have time to explore the place with your guide and enjoy some free time on the sand of the iconic Praia da Marinha.

Then, we continue by van to the Benagil area, where, with our guide, you can explore the area and see the famous Grotto of Benagil from above, stroll along the coastal trails, or take the opportunity to visit the famous Benagil Beach, where you will have time to enjoy the sea or have something to eat with a view of the sea.

The last stop is at Algar Seco, famous for its rock formations, natural caves and the iconic “Doll Cave.” There you will have a guided visit to explore the passages between natural tunnels, take incredible photos, enjoy the view over the ocean, and even cool off in a natural "pool" created by the erosion of the cliffs themselves.

Afterwards, we return to Faro in complete comfort.

This tour is ideal for travelers who want to see several must-see spots in one day, without having to worry about parking.

This immersive tour blends stunning landscapes, dramatic sea caves, charming seaside towns & rich local culture — perfect for travelers looking to experience the Algarve's magic in a single, well-curated day.

Head to your first destination, Benagil – The Algarve’s Natural Wonder. Arrive at the coastal village of Benagil, home to two of the region’s most iconic sights: the world-famous Benagil Cave (Algar de Benagil) & the picturesque Benagil Beach - the golden sands of this charming cove, framed by dramatic cliffs & turquoise waters. It’s a perfect spot for sunbathing, a short swim, or capturing postcard-worthy photos. As you explore the Benagil Cave. While venturing inside is no longer possible (you can opt for a boat ride at extra cost under good sea conditions), be led to a jaw-dropping viewpoint from which you can gaze in awe at the colossal sea cavern which is known for the opening in its top where light streams thorugh.

Land View of Benagil Cave: Take a short walk from the parking area to a cliff-top viewpoint overlooking the cave’s iconic skylight. Sea View of Benagil Cave: Choose the optional boat tour (extra cost) for an up-close view of Benagil Cave’s stunning interior from the sea. Note: Kayaking is discouraged due to safety concerns, as heavy boat traffic creates waves and challenging conditions—even for experienced kayakers. We recommend the boat tour to Benagil Cave. Tours range from 30 to 120 minutes. Prices - depending on the duration & route you choose. Your guide will assist with arrangements.

Enjoy a scenic boat tour featuring Algarve’s coastal beauty—dramatic cliffs, sea arches, hidden beaches & landmarks like Fort of Santa Catarina and the famous Benagil Cave.

Delve into the extraordinary, the Algar Seco, for a chance to explore coastal trails and pathways that wind their way through this picturesque landscape. See Boneca Cave which is often referred to as "The Doll's Cave," a captivating sea cave situated within the Algar Seco area.

Portimão / Carvoeiro / Lagos: Lunch & Free Time - Relax and explore at your own pace. Enjoy marina views, charming streets & delicious fresh seafood.

Continue to Lagos, famed for its dramatic cliffs and clear waters. Explore the Seven Hanging Valleys, swim, relax, or hike along the coast. Walk the Ponta da Piedade boardwalk to admire stunning rock formations, then enjoy free time before a scenic drive back to Lisbon.

title: Lisbon: Explore the Algarve Coast & Benagil Cave by Boat.

description:
Escape the city and discover the breathtaking coastline of southern Portugal on this unforgettable full-day Algarve tour from Lisbon. Whether you choose a Private tour or join a small group, you'll travel in comfort aboard a premium air-conditioned car or a luxurious van, accompanied by an knowledgeable English-speaking Driver and guide who will share fascinating stories, local history, and insider tips throughout the journey.

* Your first destination is the stunning ALGAR SECO.

one of the Algarve's most impressive coastal rock formations. Spend approximately 30 minutes exploring its dramatic limestone cliffs, natural pools, caves, and breathtaking viewpoints overlooking the Atlantic Ocean. This is the perfect place to capture unforgettable photographs and admire the unique geological beauty shaped by centuries of wind and waves.

* Portimão & BENAGIL CAVE Boat Tour

Next, continue to Portimão Marina, where you'll embark on one of the highlights of the day—an exciting boat tour to the world-famous Benagil Cave.

Cruise along the spectacular Algarve coastline while discovering 16 additional sea caves, hidden beaches, impressive rock formations, and natural arches that can only be appreciated from the water. Your experienced boat crew will safely navigate through the coastline while explaining the fascinating history and geology of this remarkable region.

The iconic Benagil Cave, illuminated by its famous natural skylight, is considered one of Europe's most beautiful sea caves and is an absolute must-see during any visit to Portugal.

Please note: The boat tour is operated by licensed local partners and is subject to weather and sea conditions.

* Explore the Historic Town of LAGOS.

After your coastal adventure, continue to the charming town of LAGOS, one of the Algarve's most historic and vibrant destinations.

Enjoy free time for a relaxing lunch break, where you can choose from a variety of excellent local restaurants serving fresh seafood, traditional Portuguese cuisine or international dishes.

Following lunch, visit the spectacular Ponta da Piedade, famous for its golden limestone cliffs, turquoise waters, sea arches, and panoramic viewpoints. Considered one of Portugal's most photographed natural landmarks, it offers incredible scenery in every direction.

Your final stop is the beautiful Praia do Camilo, a postcard-perfect beach reached by its famous wooden staircase. Surrounded by dramatic cliffs and crystal-clear waters, it's one of the Algarve's most iconic beaches.

After a memorable day exploring the Algarve, you'll depart Lagos at around 5:00 PM and begin the comfortable journey back to Lisbon. Relax in your air-conditioned vehicle while enjoying the scenic drive through southern Portugal. You'll arrive back in Lisbon at approximately 8:00 PM, where you'll be dropped off at your hotel or preferred location, bringing your unforgettable 10–12 hour Algarve adventure to a perfect end.

Departure from Lisbon:
Your friendly, knowledgeable guide and driver will pick you up directly from your Lisbon hotel in a comfortable private vehicle. Algar Seco – Carvoeiro
Our first stop is Algar Seco, a dramatic coastal rock formation near the charming village of Carvoeiro. Follow the scenic boardwalk to explore natural arches, sea caves, and rock pools, including the famous “Boneca” (Doll) Cave. This is a perfect spot for photographs and to take in the panoramic views of the Atlantic.

The day continues with a visit to Benagil sea cave from Portimão Marina, board a high-speed boat at 12:00 PM for a thrilling 90-minute ride along the Algarve’s spectacular coastline. Your skipper and guide will take you to: Benagill Cave –
✳️ The most iconic cave in Portugal, with its dramatic skylight and turquoise waters.
✳️10+ Secret Caves – Accessible only by boat, these hidden gems will leave you in awe.
✳️Spectacular Rock Formations – Towering cliffs, sea arches, and striking stacks.
✳️Dolphin Watching – Keep an eye out for playful wild dolphins.

✍️Note: The Boat Tour to Benagil Cave & Secret Caves (Extra Cost) - Subject to sea conditions and availability. If it’s not possible, we will instead visit the land viewpoint above Benagil Cave, offering a stunning perspective of its skylight (no sea view). Land viewpoint provided as an alternative if not possible.

Next, continue your journey to the charming town of Lagos– Lunch & Historic Center
Arrive in Lagos, one of the Algarve’s most vibrant towns. Enjoy free time for lunch at a traditional Portuguese restaurant (lunch not included), where you can savor:
✳️Freshly grilled seafood (sardines, seabass, or clams)
✳️Cataplana – the Algarve’s signature seafood stew.
✳️Spicy piri-piri chicken with fries and salad.

After lunch, wander through Lagos’ charming old town, and continue to some of the Algarve’s most stunning coastal spots:
✳️Praia Dona Ana & Praia do Camilo – Famous for golden sands, crystal-clear waters, and dramatic cliffs, accessible via wooden staircases.
✳️Ponta da Piedade – One of Portugal’s most breathtaking viewpoints, with panoramic views of towering cliffs, sea arches, and turquoise waters. Perfect for short scenic walks and unforgettable photos.

Return to Lisbon: Bid farewell to the Algarve as we head back to Lisbon. Enjoy a relaxing ride, with the option for a quick coffee stop along the way. Arrive back at your hotel in the evening, full of memories from this incredible day.

description:
Embark on a luxurious private journey along the Algarve’s most stunning coastline aboard the Princess V50, a premium yacht based in the prestigious Vilamoura Marina. This exclusive charter includes a professional skipper and stewardess, ensuring a seamless, elegant, and carefree experience for up to 8 guests.

Enjoy a full-day private charter exploring our beautiful coast. On our 8-hour tours, marvel at the iconic natural wonders of the Ria Formosa islands and experience the beauty of nature like never before. You will see crystal-clear waters, enjoy lunch at a traditional restaurant with a breathtaking view, and have the option to explore the islands, where you’ll find charming, traditional houses typical of the Algarve’s islands.
On our 4-hour tours, you will have the opportunity to visit sea caves, followed by a stop where you can make the most of the sea.
During the 3-hour tour, we explore the stunning Albufeira coastline.
On the 2 hour charter, we set off from Vilamoura Marina and enjoy stunning green views of Vale do Lobo or the cliffs — the perfect setting to enjoy the sea to the fullest, accompanied by music of your choice.
Whether you're planning a family outing, a birthday celebration, a pre-wedding celebration, a romantic escape, or a leisurely day at sea with friends or colleagues, this experiences offer the perfect setting.

Onboard the Princess V50, you'll find top-tier comfort and amenities, including paddleboard and floating buoy for added water fun. To enhance your day, we provide a gourmet platter with fresh seasonal fruit, fine cheeses, and quality charcuterie, along with a variety of refreshing drinks available throughout the cruise.

Every detail is curated to ensure an unforgettable and relaxing experience at sea. Swim in crystal-clear waters, anchor in secluded bays, explore sea caves, and make lasting memories in the comfort of your own private yacht.

Book with us and experience the Algarve coast in ultimate style and comfort aboard the Princess V50.

*Please note that the departure time is always subject to the company’s availability and must always be confirmed by the company prior to the tour.*
highlights: Luxury yacht charters with personalized service for an exclusive experience.
Flexible itineraries tailored to your preferences and schedule.
Intimate cruises for up to 8 guests with premium amenities.
Explore Algarve’s hidden gems like Benagil Cave and Ria Formosa in style.
Spacious and elegant yacht offering a relaxing and intimate atmosphere.
includes: Gourmet Tapas Selection (Fresh Fruits, Cheese, Snacks)
